solver: INC_RANS, FDS + MUSCL, implicit Euler; SA fully turbulent; SST + Langtry-Menter LM transition
usable_rule: usable = finite forces, log10 rms[P] lower at the end than at the start, CD > 0, |CL| <= 2.5; converged = usable and force history steady over the last 300 iterations (std CL < 2e-3, std CD < 2e-4)
